b.lede: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees on December 1, with Nvidia's lawyer following him on December 2. The appearances follow Huang's admission of an affair with a woman who worked for an Nvidia customer who is also believed to be a Chinese spy.
b.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will appear before a House Foreign Affairs panel amid concerns over his affair with a suspected Chinese spy
